quotes.text: Acceptance limits: Image processing, about:blank flashes and further stylesheet detection were left out or deferred. The reviewer accepted remaining misses as readable. The author later described the threshold as guaranteeing AA readability; this study does not establish that claim or formal contrast compliance.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D225298 acceptance covered the implemented readability cases. Further image handling, flashes and stylesheet detection were deferred. The author’s AA-readability statement is a historical claim, not a result established by this static study, the weighted-channel heuristic or selected tests. Link contrast reports and the intermittent load error must remain visible when using this review as evidence. Bug context remains incomplete; no complete audit or new runtime result is claimed.
title: Keep DarkReader acceptance scoped to the implemented readability cases
